responsibility: Implements RTL downward store motion using lazy code motion over the reverse CFG, targeting stores to equivalent MEM expressions that can be delayed toward exits without changing semantics. It builds a table of candidate store expressions, computes local anticipatability/availability/kill/transparency bitmaps, runs reverse-edge LCM to decide insert/delete points, then deletes original stores and inserts replacement stores on edges while respecting abnormal edges, alias analysis, and later CSE cleanup; this is exposed as the "store_motion" pass.
